question_pt: Quantas internações tiveram diagnóstico principal de diabetes mellitus?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i WHERE i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E10%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E11%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E12%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E13%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E14%'
data_quality_notes: CID-10 diabetes mellitus E10-E14, validado contra OMS e catalogo local cid.

question_pt: Quantas internações por pneumonia foram registradas?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i WHERE i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'J12%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'J13%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'J14%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'J15%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'J16%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'J17%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'J18%'
data_quality_notes: CID-10 pneumonia J12-J18; nao usar grupo local J09-J18 porque inclui influenza.

data_quality_notes: CID-10 asma J45-J46; cobre estado de mal asmatico em J46.

question_pt: Quantas internações por dengue existem no banco?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i WHERE i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'A90%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'A91%'
data_quality_notes: OMS lista dengue A90-A91/A97; o catalogo local possui A90-A91.

question_pt: Quantas internações por câncer de mama existem?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i WHERE i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C50%'

question_pt: Quantas mortes hospitalares por tuberculose ocorreram por ano?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) AS ano, COUNT(*) AS mortes FROM internacoes i WHERE i.MORTE = TRUE AND i.DT_INTER IS NOT NULL AND (i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'A15%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'A16%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'A17%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'A18%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'A19%') GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano
data_quality_notes: Tuberculose A15-A19; usa morte hospitalar MORTE=TRUE e ano de internacao.

question_pt: Quais são os 10 municípios do RS com mais internações por diabetes mellitus?
sql: SELECT m.NO_MUNICIPIO AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios m ON i.MUNIC_RES = m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D WHERE m.SG_UF = 'RS' AND (i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E10%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E11%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E12%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E13%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E14%') GROUP BY m.NO_MUNICIPIO ORDER BY internacoes DESC, municipio ASC LIMIT 10
data_quality_notes: Ranking por municipio de residencia no RS; diabetes E10-E14.

question_pt: Qual foi a evolução anual das internações por HIV/AIDS entre 2019 e 2023?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) AS ano, COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i WHERE i.DT_INTER IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND (i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'B20%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'B21%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'B22%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'B23%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'B24%') GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano

question_pt: Como as internações por hipertensão essencial se distribuem por caráter de internação?
sql: SELECT ci.DESCRICAO AS carater, COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN car_int ci ON i.CAR_INT = ci.CAR_INT WHERE i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I10%' GROUP BY ci.DESCRICAO ORDER BY internacoes DESC, carater ASC
data_quality_notes: Hipertensao essencial I10; distribui por dimensao car_int.

question_pt: Entre 2019 e 2023, qual percentual das internações por doenças isquêmicas do coração foi infarto do miocárdio por ano?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) AS ano, COUNT(*) AS internacoes_isquemicas, SUM(CASE WHEN i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I21%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I22%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS internacoes_infarto, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I21%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I22%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentual_infarto FROM internacoes i WHERE i.DT_INTER IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND (i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I20%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I21%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I22%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I23%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I24%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I25%') GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano

question_pt: Qual a taxa de mortalidade hospitalar por doenças cerebrovasculares ao longo dos anos?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) AS ano, COUNT(*) AS internacoes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.MORTE = TRUE) AS mortes, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.MORTE = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade_percentual FROM internacoes i WHERE i.DT_INTER IS NOT NULL AND (i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I60%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I61%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I62%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I63%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I64%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I65%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I66%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I67%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I68%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'I69%') GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano
data_quality_notes: Doencas cerebrovasculares I60-I69; taxa de mortalidade hospitalar = mortes/internacoes.

question_pt: Compare por ano, de 2019 a 2023, as internações por câncer de mama e câncer de próstata.
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) AS ano, SUM(CASE WHEN i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C50%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS internacoes_cancer_mama, SUM(CASE WHEN i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C61%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS internacoes_cancer_prostata FROM internacoes i WHERE i.DT_INTER IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND (i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C50%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C61%') GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano
data_quality_notes: Cancer de mama C50 e cancer de prostata C61.

question_pt: Quais são os 10 CIDs de diagnóstico principal mais frequentes dentro de apendicite, com descrição?
sql: SELECT c.CID AS cid, c.DESCRICAO AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i.DIAG_PRINC = c.CID WHERE i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'K35%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'K36%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'K37%' GROUP BY c.CID, c.DESCRICAO ORDER BY internacoes DESC, cid ASC LIMIT 10
data_quality_notes: Apendicite K35-K37; retorna CID e descricao legivel.

question_pt: Entre as mortes hospitalares por insuficiência renal, qual a distribuição por sexo?
sql: SELECT s.DESCRICAO AS sexo, COUNT(*) AS mortes FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN sexo s ON i.SEXO = s.SEXO WHERE i.MORTE = TRUE AND (i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'N17%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'N18%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'N19%') GROUP BY s.DESCRICAO ORDER BY mortes DESC, sexo ASC
data_quality_notes: Insuficiencia renal N17-N19, mortes hospitalares, dimensao sexo.

question_pt: Por ano, quantas internações por colelitíase ocorreram e qual foi a permanência média?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) AS ano, COUNT(*) AS internacoes, ROUND(AVG(i.DIAS_PERM), 2) AS permanencia_media FROM internacoes i WHERE i.DT_INTER IS NOT NULL AND i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'K80%' GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano
data_quality_notes: Colelitiase K80; permanencia media usa DIAS_PERM.
